templates.html:
<button class="btn btn--{{variant}}"{{#if disabled}} disabled{{/if}}>{{label}}</button>
<style>
.btn {
  font: 500 16px/1 system-ui, sans-serif;
  padding: 12px 20px;
  border-radius: {{radius}}px;
  border: 2px solid {{bg}};
  background: {{bg}};
  color: #FAF7F2;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.btn--secondary { background: transparent; color: {{bg}}; }
.btn--ghost { background: transparent; border-color: transparent; color: {{bg}}; }
.btn[disabled] { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }
</style>
templates.tailwind:
<button class="btn-tw btn-tw--{{variant}} px-5 py-3 text-base font-medium border-2 disabled:opacity-45 disabled:cursor-not-allowed" style="border-radius:{{radius}}px;background:{{bg}};border-color:{{bg}};color:#FAF7F2"{{#if disabled}} disabled{{/if}}>{{label}}</button>
<style>
.btn-tw--secondary { background: transparent !important; color: {{bg}}; }
.btn-tw--ghost { background: transparent !important; border-color: transparent !important; color: {{bg}}; }
</style>
